deficits.evidence: The footway is a narrow sidewalk, less than 1m wide in places, with no physical barrier separating it from the road.
deficits.suggestion: Widen the left-side footway to a minimum of 1.5m and add a physical barrier to separate pedestrians from traffic.

deficits.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the commercial nature of the street and the presence of pedestrians, but no marked or signalised crossing is visible.
deficits.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at a logical point along this stretch of road to provide a safe crossing point.

deficits.evidence: The road has four or more lanes, and any future crossing would need a refuge to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.
deficits.suggestion: Include a central refuge island in the design of the new signalised crossing to allow pedestrians to cross the wide road in two stages.
